hook: Who's telling the truth about Hormuz mines?
reel_hook: Mines in Hormuz? Depends who you ask.

slides.title: Hormuz: mines or no mines?
slides.image_prompt: A large oil tanker on dark calm water at dusk, a thin plume of smoke rising from its deck, a rusty sea mine floating in the foreground
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran says tankers hit mines; US says routes are clear.
WHY IT MATTERS
About a fifth of the world's oil normally passes here.
FOR YOU
Shipping scares in Hormuz can push oil prices up, and fuel costs with them.
slides.body: Iran says tankers hit mines; US says routes are clear. About a fifth of the world's oil normally passes here. Shipping scares in Hormuz can push oil prices up, and fuel costs with them.

slides.title: Binance promises to pay it back
slides.image_prompt: A heap of golden coins spilling out of an open steel vault door into darkness, a broken padlock lying on the floor beside them
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Binance says it'll cover all losses from a $6.3B hack.
WHY IT MATTERS
It's the largest crypto theft on record.
FOR YOU
Binance users: deposits and withdrawals were paused; the exchange says it will cover losses.
slides.body: Binance says it'll cover all losses from a $6.3B hack. It's the largest crypto theft on record. Binance users: deposits and withdrawals were paused; the exchange says it will cover losses.

slides.title: 43 million already voted
slides.image_prompt: A tall stack of sealed paper ballot envelopes beside a wooden ballot box on a table, warm morning light through a window
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Over 43 million have voted early, nearly 10M above 2022.
WHY IT MATTERS
Tuesday's vote decides which party controls Congress.
FOR YOU
US voter? Election Day is Tuesday 3 November; check your polling place now.
slides.body: Over 43 million have voted early, nearly 10M above 2022. Tuesday's vote decides which party controls Congress. US voter? Election Day is Tuesday 3 November; check your polling place now.

slides.title: Out of Oleshky, via Belarus
slides.image_prompt: A row of empty buses parked on a road at dawn, small pet carriers resting beside them, a wide misty river in the background
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Hundreds left occupied Oleshky under a one-town ceasefire.
WHY IT MATTERS
They'd gone months without regular food and medicine.
FOR YOU
Rare proof that a small local deal can get civilians out, even mid-war.
slides.body: Hundreds left occupied Oleshky under a one-town ceasefire. They'd gone months without regular food and medicine. Rare proof that a small local deal can get civilians out, even mid-war.

slides.title: Houdini died on Halloween
slides.image_prompt: Antique iron handcuffs and chains lying open on a velvet stage floor under a spotlight, a carved pumpkin glowing beside them
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Houdini died on Halloween 1926, exactly 100 years ago.
WHY IT MATTERS
Detroit, where he died, is marking the centenary.
FOR YOU
That famous 'killed by a punch' story? Historians say it's disputed.
slides.body: Houdini died on Halloween 1926, exactly 100 years ago. Detroit, where he died, is marking the centenary. That famous 'killed by a punch' story? Historians say it's disputed.
